leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply React.lazy() to dynamically import components for code splitting.
Use the Suspense component to display fallback UI while lazy components are loading.
Implement lazy loading patterns to replace static imports in route configurations.
Execute dynamic imports to separate route components into distinct bundles.
Utilize TypeScript generics with React.lazy() to maintain type safety for lazy components.
Construct route configurations that incorporate both lazy-loaded and regular components.
Define fallback components to provide user feedback during loading states.
Control loading behavior by wrapping lazy components with appropriate Suspense boundaries.
Modify existing route structures to implement lazy loading without breaking navigation.
Access lazy-loaded components within a React Router setup to enable on-demand loading.
Compare bundle sizes before and after implementing lazy loading to verify optimization.
Handle loading errors by implementing error boundaries around lazy-loaded components.
